text: I've been having acupuncture for a while now and unfortunately this has been the worst experience. It was the first time I had it in a shared room and at least for me that played a huge role. I thought it was gonna be quiet, but it wasn't. There were many machine noises and the rest of the patients were watching their phone without earphones... I could also hear construction noises nearby, so it was very hard for me to relax during the treatment. I was greeted by the female doctor, who was very kind and spoke good English, but there is no place to have a private conversation and she doesn't do an integral evaluation. The insertion of the needles was painful, the removal of them was not done by the doctor, and she was also not there anymore when I left. I do not recommend the place if you are looking for a calming, relaxing and private experience where you can feel connected with the doctor who is giving you treatment.
